title: Limit of the Gaussian CDF rotation quotient
statement: For all real $t$ and $y$, as $\theta$ tends to zero through positive values, $$\frac{\left|\Phi\left(\frac{t-\sin(\theta)y}{\cos(\theta)}\right)-\Phi(t)\right|}{\theta}\longrightarrow \varphi(t)|y|,$$ where $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ are the standard Gaussian distribution function and density.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ denote the standard Gaussian distribution function and density. For $t,y\in\mathbb R$, define $q_{t,y}(\theta)=\Phi((t-\sin\theta\,y)/\cos\theta)-\Phi(t)$. For every $t,y$, $|q_{t,y}(\theta)|/\theta\to\varphi(t)|y|$ as $\theta\to0^+$.
